digo_source: Mgombato ('mkpwoko (mikoko) red mangrove (Rhizophora mucronata)'; 'mkoko mangrove, mangrove pole'); ICRAF Useful Trees ('Digo: Mkpwoko'); Pakia 2005 ('Mkoko')
swahili: Mkoko (Mgombato also gives msinzi, msizi, mshinzi)

teaser.en: Mangrove poles were once counted in scores, and most of them came from this tree standing on its arching stilt roots.
teaser.sw: Zamani boriti za mikoko zilihesabiwa kwa korija, na nyingi zilitoka kwa mti huu uliosimama juu ya mizizi yake ya mapindi.
teaser.dg: Kare mihi ya mikoko kala inaolangbwa kpwa makorija, na minji kala inalavywa kula muhi uhu unaoima dzulu ya miziye iriyootyoka.

summary.en: *Mkpwoko*, the red mangrove, is the commonest mangrove in Kenya, standing on arching stilt roots in the mud of Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni and Vanga. Its poles built the coral-rag and mud houses of the coast, and it is now at the heart of community mangrove restoration.
summary.sw: *Mkpwoko* ni mkoko, mkoko unaopatikana kwa wingi zaidi nchini Kenya, uliosimama juu ya mizizi ya mapindi katika matope ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga. Boriti zake zilijenga nyumba za mawe ya matumbawe na za udongo za pwani, na sasa ndio kiini cha urejeshaji wa mikoko unaoendeshwa na jamii.
summary.dg: *Mkpwoko* ni mkoko unaophahikana zaidi Kenya, unaoima dzulu ya mizi iriyootyoka kpwa matope ga Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga. Nguzoze zikadzenga nyumba za mawe ga bahari na za tsi za pwani, na sambi ndio chitu cha muhimu kpwa mipango ya jamii ya kuphanda mikoko luphya.

about.en:
*Mkpwoko* grows to about 10 metres and stands on a tangle of arching stilt roots that drop from the trunk and lower branches into the mud, holding the tree above the tide. The leaves are thick, glossy and elliptical, ending in a small sharp point.

Its seed germinates while still attached to the tree. The seedling grows into a long, green, cigar-shaped 'torpedo' that hangs from the branches and then drops, spearing into the mud or floating away to root somewhere new.
about.sw:
*Mkpwoko* hukua hadi takriban mita 10 na husimama juu ya mtandao wa mizizi ya mapindi inayoshuka kutoka shina na matawi ya chini hadi kwenye matope, ikiushikilia mti juu ya maji ya bahari kujaa. Majani ni mazito, yanayong'aa na ya umbo la yai refu, yakiishia kwa ncha ndogo kali.

Mbegu yake huota ikiwa bado imeshikamana na mti. Mche hukua kuwa 'kombora' refu la kijani lenye umbo la sigara linaloning'inia kutoka matawi kisha huanguka, likichoma ndani ya matope au likielea mbali ili kuota mizizi mahali pengine.
about.dg:
*Mkpwoko* unakula hadi phephi mita 10 na unaima dzulu ya mizi minji iriyootyoka inayoshuka kula kpwa kolo na panda za photsi kuinjira matopeni, ichigbwira muhi dzulu ya madzi ga bahari. Makodza ni manene, ganang'ala na ga umbo ra yai, na ganamala na ntsa ndide.

Tembeye inamera ichiri kpwa muhi. Mutse unakula na kukala mure, wa chijani, dza 'torpedo', unaobwadzika kula kpwa panda chisha unagbwa, unadunga matope au unaelea na kuphiya kumera phatu phanjina.

where.en: This is the mangrove most visitors picture. It grows on the seaward and creek-side mud of Gazi Bay, Funzi, Shimoni and Vanga, where the stilt roots are fully visible at low tide. It is also the main tree in the Mikoko Pamoja plantations at Gazi and Makongeni, where boardwalks give an easy view into the forest.
where.sw: Huu ndio mkoko ambao wageni wengi huufikiria. Hustawi kwenye matope ya upande wa bahari na ya kando ya hori katika Ghuba ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga, ambako mizizi ya mapindi huonekana kikamilifu maji yanapokupwa. Pia ndio mti mkuu katika mashamba ya Mikoko Pamoja huko Gazi na Makongeni, ambako njia za mbao zilizoinuliwa hurahisisha kuutazama msitu.
where.dg: Hino ndio mkoko ambao ajeni anji anauwaza. Unamera kpwa matope ga uphande wa bahari na ga kanda-kanda ya mikpwono ya bahari ya Gazi, Funzi, Shimoni na Vanga, ambapho mizi iriyootyoka inaonekana yosi wakati wa madzi ga kala. Piya ndio muhi mkulu wa minda ya Mikoko Pamoja ya Gazi na Makongeni, ambapho njira za mbao zinaricha atu alole tsaka kpwa rahisi.

uses.en:
*Mkpwoko* is the great building tree of the coast. Its straight stems are cut as poles, known by size in Swahili as *boriti*, *nguzo* and *fito*, for the frames and roofs of coral-rag and mud houses. It also makes high-quality charcoal and firewood.

The bark gives tannin and dye, and the leaves and roots are used in medicine. Fishers make fish traps from the roots, and split branches are woven into baskets.

Mangrove poles have long been a source of income on the south coast, and today the carbon stored by replanted mangroves at Gazi earns money for community projects too.
uses.sw:
*Mkpwoko* ndio mti mkuu wa ujenzi pwani. Mashina yake yaliyonyooka hukatwa kuwa nguzo, zinazojulikana kwa ukubwa wake kwa Kiswahili kama *boriti*, *nguzo* na *fito*, kwa ajili ya fremu na mapaa ya nyumba za mawe ya matumbawe na za udongo. Pia hutoa makaa na kuni za ubora wa juu.

Gamba hutoa dawa ya kutia ngozi (tanini) na rangi, na majani na mizizi hutumika katika dawa. Wavuvi hutengeneza mitego ya samaki kwa mizizi, na matawi yaliyopasuliwa husukwa kuwa vikapu.

Boriti za mikoko zimekuwa chanzo cha kipato katika pwani ya kusini tangu zamani, na leo kaboni inayohifadhiwa na mikoko iliyopandwa upya huko Gazi pia huletea miradi ya jamii fedha.
uses.dg:
*Mkpwoko* ndio muhi mkulu wa kudzenga wa pwani. Mihiye ya twaa nkukatwa dza nguzo, zinazomanyikana kpwa ukulu kpwa Chiswahili dza *boriti*, *nguzo* na *fito*, kuhenda mifupa na mapaa ga nyumba za mawe ga bahari na za tsi. Piya unalavya makala na kuni nono sana.

Gopha rinalavya tanini na rangi, na makodza na mizi nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa. Avuvi nkuhenda mihambo ya ng'onda kula kpwa mizi, na panda zirizogbwanyulwa nkusukwa kaphu.

Nguzo za mikoko zikakala njira ya mapato pwani ya kusini kula kare, na rero kaboni inayoikpwa ni mikoko iriyophandwa luphya Gazi inaphaha pesa za mipango ya jamii piya.

culture.en: Mangrove poles are counted in scores: the Mgombato dictionary records *korija*, twenty items together, with mangrove poles for building as its example. Pakia notes that the Digo group *mutsu*, *mdzago* and *mkoko* together as *mikoko*, the mangroves.
culture.sw: Boriti za mikoko huhesabiwa kwa korija: kamusi ya Mgombato inarekodi *korija*, vitu ishirini kwa pamoja, ikitoa boriti za mikoko za ujenzi kama mfano. Pakia anabainisha kwamba Wadigo huweka *mutsu*, *mdzago* na *mkoko* pamoja kama *mikoko*.
culture.dg: Nguzo za mikoko nkuolangbwa kpwa makorija: kamusi ya Mgombato inaandika *korija*, vitu makumi mairi phamwenga, na mfwanowe ni nguzo za mikoko za kudzengera. Pakia anaandika kukala Adigo anaika *mutsu*, *mdzago* na *mkoko* phamwenga dza *mikoko*.

names.en: The Mgombato dictionary gives *mkpwoko* (plural *mikoko*) for the red mangrove and *mkoko* for a mangrove or mangrove pole used in building; the ICRAF handbook also gives *mkpwoko*, while Pakia writes *mkoko*. In Swahili it is *mkoko*, and Mgombato also lists *msinzi*, *msizi* and *mshinzi*. Duruma and Giriama speakers also call it *mkoko*. In English it is the red or loop-root mangrove, and botanists call it *Rhizophora mucronata*.
names.sw: Kamusi ya Mgombato inatoa *mkpwoko* (wingi *mikoko*) kwa mkoko huu na *mkoko* kwa mkoko au boriti ya mkoko inayotumika katika ujenzi; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF pia kinatoa *mkpwoko*, huku Pakia akiandika *mkoko*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *mkoko*, na Mgombato pia anaorodhesha *msinzi*, *msizi* na *mshinzi*. Wazungumzaji wa Kiduruma na Kigiriama pia huuita *mkoko*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *red mangrove* au *loop-root mangrove*, na wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Rhizophora mucronata*.
names.dg: Kamusi ya Mgombato inapha *mkpwoko* (wingi *mikoko*) kpwa mkoko uhu na *mkoko* kpwa mkoko au nguzo ya mkoko ya kudzengera; chitabu cha ICRAF piya chinapha *mkpwoko*, ela Pakia anaandika *mkoko*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mkoko*, na Mgombato piya inaandika *msinzi*, *msizi* na *mshinzi*. Aduruma na Agiryama piya anauiha *mkoko*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *red mangrove* au *loop-root mangrove*, na asayansi a mimea anauiha *Rhizophora mucronata*.

conservation.en: Globally it is Least Concern, but Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service. Community projects at Gazi and Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) and at Vanga, Jimbo and Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) replant this tree and fund local projects from mangrove carbon.
conservation.sw: Kimataifa uko katika kundi la Wasiwasi Mdogo (Least Concern), lakini mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na kuni, kwa hivyo uvunaji hutolewa leseni na Shirika la Huduma za Misitu Kenya (Kenya Forest Service). Miradi ya jamii huko Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na huko Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) hupanda upya mti huu na hufadhili miradi ya ndani kwa fedha za kaboni ya mikoko.
conservation.dg: Duniani tauri hatarini, ela mikoko ya Kenya inakatwa sana kpwa nguzo na kuni, kpwa hivyo kuikata kunahitaji leseni ya Kenya Forest Service. Mipango ya jamii ya Gazi na Makongeni (Mikoko Pamoja) na ya Vanga, Jimbo na Kiwegu (Vanga Blue Forest) inaphanda muhi uhu luphya na kuriphira mipango ya hipha kula kpwa kaboni ya mikoko.
